content.short: Orbiter Finance is a decentralized cross-rollup bridge for Ethereum native assets.
content.description: Orbiter Finance is a decentralized cross-rollup bridge for moving Ethereum-native assets. It delivers low-cost, near-instant transfers across multiple rollups. The bridge supports cross-rollup transfers (ETH, USDC, USDT, DAI) between Ethereum and networks including StarkNet, zkSync, Loopring, Arbitrum and Arbitrum Nova, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, ZKSpace, Immutable X, dYdX, Metis, and Boba. A Maker program is live on testnet, inviting liquidity providers to participate soon.
